Chapter 1109: 30: Rewards (Subscription Request)

Chapter 1109: Chapter 30: Rewards (Subscription Request)

The fierce sun surged.

Lin Yuan slightly activated the Divine Body of the Fierce Sun, and the world of the Fierce Sun naturally formed.

This suppressed the many war machines of the Purple Dream Domain below, rendering them immobile.

This was the terrifying boost brought by more than thirty thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun to the Divine Body of the Fierce Sun.

Buzz buzz buzz.

Under Lin Yuan’s overlook, the war machines in the Purple Dream Domain below began to fall into an irreversible ‘self-destruction’.

“What a pity.”

Lin Yuan glanced down and knew he couldn’t stop this kind of ‘self-destruction’.

Every war machine, even the lowest level Grade C war machines, was unique and contained Chaos Secret Patterns, which were the top secrets of each Ancient Country.

Therefore.

Inside every war machine, ‘self-destruction’ patterns were engraved. Once they were out of control, they would self-destruct immediately.

If they didn’t self-destruct and fell into enemy hands, the Chaos Secret Patterns could be studied and replicated, enabling the production of identical war machines.

This was unacceptable to the Ancient Countries.

Previously, when Lin Yuan saw Thunder Spear Great Honored attack a Grade B war machine, he immediately intervened, fearing the methods would trigger the ‘self-destruction’ patterns inside the Grade B war machine.

“Even though they self-destruct, the materials that remain have high value.”

Lin Yuan watched as the war machines crumbled.

The construction of war machines not only required the engraving of corresponding Chaos Secret Patterns but also very precious materials.

After all, they needed to withstand the power of hundreds or thousands of Lord-level experts and amplify it. If the materials were slightly weaker, they couldn’t even deliver a threatening strike to a Great Lord and would disintegrate directly.

“These remaining materials, along with the credit earned from defeating the enemy, should be substantial, allowing for the exchange of many cultivation resources.”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood.

He glanced at Thunder Spear Great Honored, who had already fled deep into the Purple Dream Domain.

Thunder Spear Great Honored’s strength was much greater than that of the Nine Profound Venerable of the Chaos Void.

If Lin Yuan forcibly tried to kill him, he could do so, but it would certainly involve a chase.

In doing so, he would have to venture deep into the heart of the Purple Dream Domain, which could lead to many variables, including being encircled by multiple peak Great Lords or even encountering Heavenly Venerate-level experts…

Lin Yuan might find it hard to retreat unscathed.

So Lin Yuan had no intention of capturing Thunder Spear Great Honored.

“My strength is still too weak.”

“If I could completely refine the second layer of ‘Infinite Void’ and possess near Great Lord-invincible strength, I would have confidence in capturing Thunder Spear Great Honored.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As an enemy Great Lord, if Lin Yuan killed him, he would certainly receive significant credit.

Even though Thunder Spear Great Honored had life-preserving methods and couldn’t completely fall, allowing him to revive.

But it would take time to fully recover his strength.

In the upcoming war, he might not be able to make a move.

All these would be counted as credit.

During wartime, killing the true body of an enemy Great Lord isn’t an easy task because they would hardly ever be alone.

Thus, the rewards for a successful kill would be substantial.

…

Clatter.

After confirming Thunder Spear Great Honored dared not return, Lin Yuan flipped his hand, and that Grade B war machine appeared, landing not far away.

To ensure that this war machine was not damaged, Lin Yuan only took it out at this moment.

“Great Lord.”

“Thank you, Great Lord, for your intervention.”

From within the Grade B war machine, the single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ and the other peak Lord-level dominators flew out together, expressing their immense gratitude to Lin Yuan.

At this moment, they also realized that if it weren’t for Lin Yuan, they would have likely perished under Thunder Spear Great Honored’s last attack.

“No need.”

Lin Yuan shook his head, “The enemy has been defeated; you all should clean up the battlefield now.”

All the war machines of the Purple Dream Domain had self-destructed, and many Lord-level experts inside had been captured as Lin Yuan’s war prisoners.

For these war prisoners, various Ancient Countries had a relatively tacit way of handling them.

Which was to exchange them back through ‘redeeming’ after the war ended.

So Lin Yuan did not mistreat these war prisoners but casually confined them in some corner of his internal universe.

“Yes.”

“Yes.”

“The Great Lord’s intervention directly frightened Thunder Spear Great Honored into a hasty escape.”

At this moment, the single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ and the other peak Lords couldn’t help but praise.

Even though they had all been inside the war machine, collected by Lin Yuan, their communication among their avatars allowed them to understand roughly what had happened.

“Defeating Thunder Spear Great Honored is nothing; whether the war is won or lost mainly depends on the battles at the core defense lines.”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, having a clear understanding of himself.

Compared to this war involving dozens of major domains, he couldn’t influence much.

“That still is a victory on the local defense line.”

The single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ immediately said.

“You all may leave.”

With that, Lin Yuan’s form disappeared.

…

After Lin Yuan left.

The single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ and the other peak Lord-level experts finally raised their heads.

“Originally thought we’d need to fight a hard battle, didn’t expect it to end so quickly.” One of the peak Lord-level experts remarked with some emotion.

“It’s all because of Great Venerate of the Galaxy.”

The single-horned man ‘Luo Peng’ said.

“Yes, it’s because of Great Venerate of the Galaxy.”

The other few peak Lord-level experts nodded. Without Great Venerate of the Galaxy, even if they could resist the enemy, they would have to pay a hefty price, perhaps even self-destructing some war machines.

…

Lin Yuan returned to the rear of the defense line.

He observed the battles between the peak Great Lords in the core defense region.

Half a day later.

Great Lords on both sides gradually ceased fighting.

The war had just begun; the mighty Great Lords on both sides were primarily testing each other, without launching true attacks.

Such as the direct confrontation between Lin Yuan and Thunder Spear Great Honored, were quite rare.

…

A moment later.

Lin Yuan was planning to continue comprehending the battle machinery.

Lord Qingfen arrived with a projection.

“Galaxy.”

Lord Qingfen smiled contentedly at Lin Yuan, feeling immense satisfaction.

Lin Yuan’s strength had brought honor amongst the peak Great Lords.

Many peak Great Lords were unmatched in battle, yet teaching disciples was their weakness.

Teaching a Great Lord level disciple was incredibly difficult, let alone one approaching the peak Great Lord level?

“Prince Red Pine wishes to see you.”

Lord Qingfen directly stated his intention.

“Red Pine King wants to see me?” Lin Yuan was slightly surprised.

The so-called Prince Red Pine is indeed Red Pine King; royalty who are crowned prefer being addressed as ‘Prince.’

“Correct.”

Lord Qingfen nodded.

“Don’t worry, it’s a good thing.”

Lord Qingfen explained: “You defeated Thunder Spear Great Honored; although not in the core defense region, it boosted the morale on our side, making Prince Red Pine very pleased.”

“Prince Red Pine is pleased…”

Lord Qingfen looked at Lin Yuan: “If you have any requests, you can take this opportunity to ask. Even if the Prince doesn’t agree, it’s fine. If he does, it’s a gain…”

“Can it work like that?” Lin Yuan blinked.

“Prince Red Pine being pleased is a good thing, many things can be lenient.” Lord Qingfen said.

He understood Red Pine King quite well.

“I’ll take you there now.”

Lord Qingfen immediately took Lin Yuan, traversing the void together.

After only dozens of traverses, they arrived at a small city floating in the air. This city wasn’t large, spanning only billions of miles, akin to a small cavern abode.

Whosh.

Lord Qingfen led Lin Yuan to a pavilion inside the small city.

“Prince, Galaxy has arrived.”

Lord Qingfen announced.

“Come in.”

A gentle voice sounded.

Lin Yuan followed Lord Qingfen inside and saw Red Pine King seated in the center of the pavilion.

Red Pine King was also a Great Lord level powerhouse, but the pressure he exerted on Lin Yuan was far superior to Lord Qingfen or even Great Venerate Hongye.

“Galaxy, have a seat.”

Red Pine King smiled at Lin Yuan, showing no royal pretense.

Lin Yuan immediately took a seat.

“I’m very pleased with your performance on the battlefield.” Red Pine King smiled and said, “Tell me, what reward do you want?”

Lord Qingfen stood beside without any action.

“A reward…..”

Lin Yuan recalled Lord Qingfen’s reminder, knowing this was an opportunity to be bold, even if unsuccessful, it would not matter.

“What should I ask for?” Lin Yuan’s mind was filled with thoughts.

Resources? There are numerous ways to acquire resources, no need to waste this chance here.

“Prince…” Lin Yuan quickly made a decision, “I wish to comprehend the Class A battle machinery.”

So far, the battle machinery Lin Yuan could access was only Class B Intermediate.

And this level of battle machinery was already the limit; as for the higher Class A, it only existed in the core defense battlefield.

Even if Lin Yuan went to the core defense battlefield, the commanders there were peak Great Lords, expecting to freely comprehend battle machinery like in the Ding Seven Defense Line?

Very difficult to achieve.

Even if Lord Qingfen secretly helped, it couldn’t be unknown to Red Pine King.

“Comprehend Class A battle machinery?”

Lord Qingfen’s expression slightly changed upon hearing this.

He didn’t expect Lin Yuan would dare to make such a request.

Class A battle machinery can host thousands to tens of thousands of peak dominator level powerhouses, a single strike threatening peak Great Lord existence.

This level of battle machinery could influence local war outcomes, even Lord Qingfen couldn’t approach any Class A battle machinery at will.

Lin Yuan’s request seemed unlikely to Lord Qingfen.

Even if Red Pine King was in high spirits, Class A battle machinery involved Ancient Country’s foundation, which was clearly understood by Red Pine King.

If it were for some treasure or relic, Lord Qingfen believed Red Pine King might agree, but Class A battle machinery?

If Red Pine King dared agree, he too would bear some risk.

If the Chaos Secret Patterns within the Class A battle machinery Lin Yuan comprehends get leaked, Red Pine King would be the primary responsible party.

“Class A battle machinery?”

Red Pine King raised an eyebrow and shook his head saying: “You sure know how to ask.”

Lin Yuan realized from Red Pine King’s words the significant importance of Class A battle machinery, even beyond his estimation.

“But I can’t resist being so pleased with you.”

Red Pine King smiled at Lin Yuan, “Since you wish to comprehend Class A battle machinery, you can comprehend all those used in this war.”
